description: Imagine a bike that combines lightweight design with effortless functionality – that’s the Explorer CT Step-Through Hybrid Bike. This bike isn't just about getting from A to B; it's about enjoying the journey with comfort and style. Designed with the modern woman in mind, it’s the perfect companion for everything from daily commutes to weekend explorations. Lightweight and Durable Aluminum Frame: The Explorer CT features a sleek aluminum frame that is both incredibly lightweight and remarkably durable. This ensures easy handling and effortless maneuverability, making it a joy to ride, whether you're navigating city streets or exploring local bike paths. Step-Through Design for Easy Mounting and Dismounting: The step-through frame is a standout feature, allowing for easy mounting and dismounting. This design is especially beneficial for those who value convenience and comfort, making it accessible for riders of all ages and mobility levels. Smooth and Reliable 7-Speed Gear System: Equipped with a reliable Shimano 7-speed gear system, the Explorer CT provides smooth and precise shifting for various terrains. Whether you're tackling gentle hills or cruising on flat roads, this system ensures an enjoyable and efficient ride, adapting seamlessly to your journey. Comfortable Upright Riding Position: Designed with an upright riding position, this bike reduces strain on your back and shoulders. This allows for a more relaxed and comfortable riding experience, making it perfect for longer rides and daily use. Enhanced Stability with 700C Wheelset: The 700C wheelset enhances efficiency and stability, providing a smooth ride on paved paths and suburban streets. This ensures that you'll have a confident and stable ride, no matter where your journey takes you. Comfort-Focused Design: The bike also features a padded comfort saddle and easy-to-reach handlebars, which contribute to the overall relaxed experience. These features ensure that you’ll be comfortable, even on longer rides, making it an ideal choice for casual riders and daily commuters alike. Stylish and Timeless Aesthetics: The Explorer CT is available in modern color options, ensuring you'll look as good as you feel on every ride. This bike combines classic design with modern touches to elevate your riding experience. The Explorer CT Step-Through Hybrid Bike combines lightweight construction, simplicity, and timeless style to enhance your riding experience. It's designed for women who seek a bike that's both functional and fashionable. Whether you’re heading to the park, exploring city streets, or cruising to your favorite coffee shop, the Explorer CT is your perfect companion. Frame: 700C x 16" Aluminum Frame Fork: Steel Tire: Black Tire 700C x 38C Rim: Alloy Double Wall Spoke: Stainless Steel Chainwheel: Pro Alloy 3 PC 40T Pedal: 9/16" R. Derailleur: Shimano 7-Speed Shifter: Shimano SL-RS35 Freewheel: Shimano MF-TZ21 14-28T Brake lever: Tektro Alloy Brake: Tektro V Brake Handlebar: Satin Steel Stem: Alloy Grip: Rubber Saddle: Comfort Sport Seat Post: Alloy Seat clamp: Alloy Weight of bike: 28lbs Fits riders from 5 feet 3 inch to 6 feet 1 inch tall
